p: Bridge Street is in the heart of St Helens town centre, close to the shops and the bus station. St Helens is famous for glassmaking, and Pilkington was founded here, so the town's industrial story is a big part of its character.

The World of Glass museum, by the canal, tells that story and is a good one to visit with the kids. St Helens is also rugby league country, home of the Saints, and on the edge of town Dream, the giant white head sculpture on the old Sutton Manor Colliery site, can be seen from the M62.
Reel Time is an 18+ venue, so keep that in mind if the family's with you.
